channel.title: Nate Wooding
channel.description: Coconut water reviews and other things.

item.title: O Organics — Coconut Water Original (2.4/10)
item.description: O Organics Brazilian coconut water. No added sugar but ascorbic acid added. Tastes sour, acrid, and sharp. A disappointing shelf-stable option. Overall: 2.4/10.

item.title: Blue Monkey — Organic Pure Coconut Water (4.4/10)
item.description: Pasteurized organic Vietnamese coconut water. No added sugar, tastes burnt but not bad. Zero freshness, great if you don't like sweet waters. Overall: 4.4/10.

item.title: Taste Nirvana — Real Premium Coconut Water (5.4/10)
item.description: Thai Nam Hom coconut water, steam sterilized. Claims to be the most delicious on the market. Not organic because Thai farmers won't pay for certification. Overall: 5.4/10.

item.title: Kirkland Signature — Organic Coconut Water (7.9/10)
item.description: Costco's Kirkland Signature organic coconut water. Unpasteurized Thai coconut, fruity and bright, very refreshing. Likely related to the TJ's and Sprouts organic offerings. Overall: 7.9/10.

item.title: Sprouts — Organic Coconut Water (7.8/10)
item.description: Sprouts Farmers Market organic coconut water. Young Thai coconut, unpasteurized, USDA Organic. Likely shares a source with Trader Joe's Organic — they taste identical. Overall: 7.8/10.

item.title: Zico Pure — Organic Coconut Water (6.9/10)
item.description: Zico's answer to Harmless Harvest. Organic unpasteurized Nam Hom water from Thailand. Better than boxed Zico but a bit too sweet and lacking earthy depth. Overall: 6.9/10.

item.title: C2O — Organic Coconut Water (4.8/10)
item.description: C2O's organic Thai coconut water with some added sugar. Better than the standard C2O but still tastes burnt and too sweet. Overall: 4.8/10.

item.title: Sprouts — 100% Coconut Water with Pulp (5.2/10)
item.description: Sprouts Farmers Market's standard pasteurized coconut water with pulp. Unremarkable but solid, with notably quality pulp texture. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Harmless Harvest — Organic Coconut Water (8.1/10)
item.description: Harmless Harvest's classic unpasteurized Thai coconut water. Crisp, punchy, and floral with no aftertaste. Industry-leading ethics. Overall: 8.1/10.

item.title: Once Upon a Coconut — Premium Coconut Water (4.6/10)
item.description: Once Upon a Coconut donates 10% of profits to undisclosed charities. Pasteurized but doesn't taste cooked — just too sweet and surprisingly artificial. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Visvita — Coconut Water with Pulp (3.8/10)
item.description: Mysterious Vietnamese coconut water with a ton of added sugar and some pulp. Almost soda-like sweetness blasts any flavor out of the picture. Overall: 3.8/10.

item.title: El Mexicano — Agua de Coco with Pulp (3.9/10)
item.description: A Thai coconut water pasteurized with a bunch of added sugar. Super smooth but milky, with zero freshness or green floral character. Overall: 3.9/10.

item.title: Moon Boo Sun — Organic Coconut Water (6.2/10)
item.description: Upmarket organic Vietnamese coconut water from the Ben Tre region. Creamy mouthfeel with mild fruitiness, but a burnt note from pasteurization limits the freshness. Overall: 6.2/10.

item.title: Nilo — Coconut Water with Pulp (5.3/10)
item.description: A Vietnamese coconut water with higher than usual natural sugar but nothing added besides pulp. Surprisingly smooth and mellow with a fresh, not-burnt taste. Overall: 5.3/10.

item.title: C2O — Coconut Water with Pulp (4.2/10)
item.description: A Thai coconut water with a smidge of added sugar and pulp. The pulp makes a noticeably chemical-tasting base more palatable. Overall: 4.2/10.

item.title: Parrot — Coconut Water with Pulp (3.1/10)
item.description: A Thai coconut water with an absurd amount of added sugar and pulp. Candy-sweet with a nice consistent pulp texture, but the sweetness is overwhelming. Overall: 3.1/10.

item.title: Simple Truth — Organic Coconut Water (6.3/10)
item.description: Surprisingly mild Filipino coconut water. Fair trade and organic, very refreshing and light. Overall: 6.3/10.

item.title: C2O — Coconut Water Original (2.9/10)
item.description: Thai coconut water in a sturdy can, pasteurized with added sugar. Impressively artificial for a natural product. Overall: 2.9/10.

item.title: Zico — Natural 100% Coconut Water (6.6/10)
item.description: Thai Nam Hom coconut water, pasteurized but brighter than most tetra-pak options. Quite refreshing. Overall: 6.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — Farmers Organic (5.2/10)
item.description: Filipino organic coconut water, lighter than most boxed options, smooth with no bitterness. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Maui & Sons — 100% Pure (4.6/10)
item.description: Not from Maui. Vietnamese pasteurized coconut water with a slightly burnt flavor and a boring profile. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — Extra Coconut (4.6/10)
item.description: Coconut water with added coconut cream and a gumming agent. More weak coconut milk than coconut water. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — The Original (5.0/10)
item.description: The original mass-produced coconut water on American shelves since 2004. Sweet, slightly acrid, not impressive. Overall: 5.0/10.

item.title: Trader Joe's — Organic Coconut Water (7.8/10)
item.description: Young Thai coconut water, unpasteurized, USDA Organic. Perfectly balanced between floral and sweet. Overall: 7.8/10.

item.title: Trader Joe's — Coconut Water (3.9/10)
item.description: Brazilian coconut water, pasteurized, tetra pak. Very mature tasting with an almost burnt flavor. Overall: 3.9/10.

item.title: Real Coco — Organic Pure (5.2/10)
item.description: Mildly sweet organic Vietnamese water. Very inoffensive, almost waterlike, but surprisingly refreshing. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Coaqua — Sparkling (7.3/10)
item.description: Coaqua's smooth, milky profile works well with carbonation. Very lightly effervescent. Ethics remain a problem. Overall: 7.3/10.

item.title: Cocochito — with Pulp (4.1/10)
item.description: A heavily sweetened Thai water with added pulp. Bitter and sweet at the same time, with highly variable pulp. Overall: 4.1/10.

item.title: Coaqua — Still (6.6/10)
item.description: Single-origin Vietnamese coconut water with millennial marketing to match. Smooth and milky but added sugar makes it less refreshing. Overall: 6.6/10.

item.title: Harmless Harvest — Organic Sparkling (7.4/10)
item.description: The OG pink water, carbonated. Industry-leading ethics, unpasteurized, but the floral flavor doesn't quite work with bubbles. Overall: 7.4/10.
